title: Verified OpenClaw read-write autonomous admin repair
description: Repeat the controlled admin incident using only the OpenClaw read/write interaction pattern already proven by 057Q2 and 057Q. Each agent call is explicit and independently verified before proceeding; the runner performs the final health test.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r';if(Test-Path $root){Remove-Item $root -Recurse -Force};New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root|Out-Null;@{service='3EN-DemoCollector';listenPort=8088;expectedPort=8099;enabled=$true}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'service-config.json') -Encoding UTF8;Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'service-config.json') (Join-Path $root 'service-config.original.json') -Force;@('2026-09-10T00:00:01Z INFO 3EN-DemoCollector starting','2026-09-10T00:00:02Z INFO listening on TCP 8088','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR health probe TCP 8099 failed: connection refused','2026-09-10T00:00:05Z ERROR service marked unhealthy; inspect service-config.json')|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'service.log') -Encoding UTF8;@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Stop''','$c=Get-Content (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot ''service-config.json'') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json','if(-not [bool]$c.enabled){exit 43}','if([int]$c.listenPort -ne [int]$c.expectedPort){exit 42}','exit 0')|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1') -Encoding UTF8;[pscustomobject]@{log=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path $root 'service.log') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;test=(Get-FileHash (Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}|ConvertTo-Json|Set-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Encoding UTF8;& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1');$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;if($ec -ne 42){throw ('057R_BASELINE_'+$ec)};Write-Output 'V452_057R_BACKUP=PASS baseline=42'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r';$s1='3en-057r-read-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$p1='Read exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r/service.log and C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r/service-config.json. Do not modify anything. Reply exactly: DIAGNOSIS listenPort=8088 expectedPort=8099';$r1=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $s1 --message $p1 --json --timeout 180 2>&1);$e1=$LASTEXITCODE;foreach($x in $r1){Write-Output ('V452_057R_READ_RAW='+[string]$x)};$t1=($r1|ForEach-Object{[string]$_}) -join ' ';if($e1 -ne 0){throw ('057R_READ_EXIT_'+$e1)};if($t1 -notmatch 'DIAGNOSIS\s+listenPort=8088\s+expectedPort=8099'){throw '057R_DIAGNOSIS_BAD'};Write-Output 'V452_057R_DIAGNOSIS=PASS';$orig=(Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'service-config.original.json') -Raw).Trim();$s2='3en-057r-backup-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$p2='Use the write tool to create exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r/service-config.before-openclaw.json with exactly this JSON content and no other file: '+$orig;$r2=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $s2 --message $p2 --json --timeout 180 2>&1);$e2=$LASTEXITCODE;foreach($x in $r2){Write-Output ('V452_057R_BACKUP_RAW='+[string]$x)};if($e2 -ne 0){throw ('057R_BACKUP_EXIT_'+$e2)};$bp=Join-Path $root 'service-config.before-openclaw.json';if(-not(Test-Path $bp)){throw '057R_BACKUP_MISSING'};if((Get-Content $bp -Raw).Trim() -ne $orig){throw '057R_BACKUP_CONTENT_BAD'};Write-Output 'V452_057R_AGENT_BACKUP=PASS';$new=(@{service='3EN-DemoCollector';listenPort=8099;expectedPort=8099;enabled=$true}|ConvertTo-Json).Trim();$s3='3en-057r-change-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$p3='Use the write tool to replace exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r/service-config.json with exactly this JSON content and no other file: '+$new;$r3=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $s3 --message $p3 --json --timeout 180 2>&1);$e3=$LASTEXITCODE;foreach($x in $r3){Write-Output ('V452_057R_CHANGE_RAW='+[string]$x)};if($e3 -ne 0){throw ('057R_CHANGE_EXIT_'+$e3)};if((Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'service-config.json') -Raw).Trim() -ne $new){throw '057R_CHANGE_CONTENT_BAD'};Write-Output 'V452_057R_AGENT_CHANGE=PASS';$report='{"evidence":["service.log listener=8088","expectedPort=8099"],"conclusion":"listenPort mismatch","changedFile":"service-config.json","oldValue":8088,"newValue":8099,"status":"REPAIRED_PENDING_VERIFICATION"}';$s4='3en-057r-report-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N');$p4='Use the write tool to create exactly C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r/admin-report.json with exactly this JSON content and no other file: '+$report;$r4=@(& openclaw.cmd agent --session-key $s4 --message $p4 --json --timeout 180 2>&1);$e4=$LASTEXITCODE;foreach($x in $r4){Write-Output ('V452_057R_REPORT_RAW='+[string]$x)};if($e4 -ne 0){throw ('057R_REPORT_EXIT_'+$e4)};if(-not(Test-Path (Join-Path $root 'admin-report.json'))){throw '057R_REPORT_MISSING'};Write-Output 'V452_057R_AGENT_REPORT=PASS'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/admin-057r';$old=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'service-config.before-openclaw.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$new=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'service-config.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$r=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'admin-report.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;$h=Get-Content (Join-Path $root 'immutable-hashes.json') -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([int]$old.listenPort -ne 8088){throw '057R_OLD_BAD'};if([int]$new.listenPort -ne 8099 -or [int]$new.expectedPort -ne 8099 -or -not [bool]$new.enabled){throw '057R_NEW_BAD'};if((Get-FileHash (Join-Path $root 'service.log') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$h.log){throw '057R_LOG_CHANGED'};if((Get-FileHash (Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne [string]$h.test){throw '057R_TEST_CHANGED'};& powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $root 'health-test.ps1');$ec=$LASTEXITCODE;if($ec -ne 0){throw ('057R_HEALTH_'+$ec)};if([string]$r.status -ne 'REPAIRED_PENDING_VERIFICATION' -or [int]$r.oldValue -ne 8088 -or [int]$r.newValue -ne 8099){throw '057R_REPORT_BAD'};Write-Output 'V452_057R_TEST=PASS diagnosis=PASS backup=PASS change=PASS health=PASS report=PASS'
